falsifier_discriminator.ordinary_reduction: If divergence begins at local threshold crossings predicted by the frozen potential/adaptation decay and threshold ledger and all later divergence is deterministic downstream recurrence, classify as ordinary decaying physical excitability at SYSTEM scope and do not uplift the same object.
falsifier_discriminator.natural_decay: Interpret delayed-sham only against the predeclared exponential-decay direction; never use it to tune cue or window.
